title: Grateful Dead Live at Sacramento Memorial Auditorium on 1972-08-12
source: Source Info: 7" Master Soundboard Reels @7.5ips 1/2trk > Garcia's reel @ 3.75 ips > Will Boswell's reel @ 3.75 ips (Maxell UDXL); Transfer Info: Technics RS1506 > Tascam DA-3000 > Adobe Audition > TLH flac2496

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard mix captures a smoking 8‑12‑72 show with a monster Other One → Truckin' second‑set jam.
ai_review.review: All three reviewers hail this as the definitive copy of the August 12, 1972 concert, praising the crystal‑clear mix that lets Phil’s bass and Keith’s keys shine without overpowering the band. The performance is described as “smokin’” with a standout second set – especially the Other One sandwich and a high‑gear Truckin' jam – delivering high energy throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently five‑star reviews emphasize both an excellent soundboard recording and a high‑energy, standout performance.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix is praised as crystal‑clear; Phil’s bass and Keith’s keyboards are strong yet balanced, with no reported dropouts or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set builds momentum, highlighted by an incredible Other One sandwich that flows into a high‑gear Truckin', delivering the show’s peak energy.

band_member_comments.Phil: Noted as nicely present in the mix and “nice” throughout the performance.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s keyboards are described as strong but well‑balanced in the mix.
